Container.Name: civicwatch
Container.Requires: A Postgres 18 + pgvector container holding the archive. See deploy/postgres-unraid.md.
Container.Overview:
A searchable, speaker-attributed archive of local government meetings, with an agent that answers questions and cites the moment in the recording.
One container: the reader API and the reading surfaces together. The UI reaches the API over 127.0.0.1 inside the container, so the API is never on the network and the curation console is not reachable through this container at all.
Put a reverse proxy in front for TLS. After it starts, check the log for "dense retrieval READY" - if it says UNAVAILABLE, the model cache path below is not writable by uid 65534 and search is running on BM25 alone.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: The site. Point the reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: Model cache
Config.Description: Where the 0.6B embedding model is cached. MUST be writable by uid 65534 - the container runs as nobody. Run: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/civicwatch/models && chown -R 65534:65534 /mnt/user/appdata/civicwatch/models. Get this wrong and the model never loads, search silently degrades to BM25 only, and the container still looks healthy.

Config.Name: Voice
Config.Description: Where the text-to-speech model is cached, so /ask can read an answer aloud. 338 MB, fetched on first use like the embedding model above, and MUST be writable by uid 65534. Run: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/civicwatch/voice && chown -R 65534:65534 /mnt/user/appdata/civicwatch/voice. Leave it unmapped and the archive still serves everything else; the read-aloud control simply reports that it has no voice.

Config.Name: Spoken audio
Config.Description: Rendered speech, kept between restarts. An answer is immutable, so its audio is rendered once and every listener after the first pays nothing; unmapped, that work is redone after every container recreation. About 700 KB per answer. Same ownership requirement as the two above.

Config.Name: CIVIC_DSN
Config.Description: Postgres connection string, e.g. postgresql://civic:PASSWORD@10.0.0.6:5432/civic_meetings. Was called PASCO_DSN, which the image still accepts: on an existing container, add this one and remove the old at your leisure, in either order.

Config.Name: SITE_URL
Config.Description: The public origin. Read at run time by the sitemap, robots.txt, canonical links and Open Graph tags. Nothing is baked into the image, which is what lets one image serve any county.

Config.Name: SITE_CONTACT
Config.Description: Where a reader sends a correction. /about shows it only when set, and never offers a dead link.

Config.Name: ASK_TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: 1 when a reverse proxy is in front. At 0 behind a proxy, every visitor looks like one address and the whole internet shares a single rate-limit bucket. Only set it with a proxy actually in front - at 1 with nothing forwarding, a caller can forge their address.

Config.Name: ASK_ASKER_KEY
Config.Description: Secret for counting people rather than questions. With it set, every arrival at /api/ask is filed under an HMAC of the caller's address and the LOCAL DATE - enough to count distinct people per day, useless for following one across two days, and not reversible to an address without this key. Unset, the arrivals are still counted and the identity column stays empty. Keep it in step with env.local.sh, and note that changing it counts a person either side of the change as two.

Config.Name: ASK_DAILY_MAX
Config.Description: Questions per 24h across all callers. This is a MONEY ceiling: about $3.60/day typical, $30/day worst case.

Config.Name: LLM_API_KEY
Config.Description: Inference key. Used ONLY by /api/ask. Search, browse and the published record are local and work without it.

Config.Name: INFERENCE_API_BASE
Config.Description: Base URL of the inference API. /api/ask only. Leave the default unless you are pointing at a different provider - an EMPTY value used to collapse the request URL to /v1/chat/completions and Ask failed with 'unknown url type'.

Config.Name: LLM_MODEL_AGENT
Config.Description: Model name the agent calls. /api/ask only.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone. Match the Postgres container or timestamps disagree.
